blocks.text:
Breakfast at the hotel. A rich excursion program awaits you!

After breakfast, you head to the Brazilian side of the Foz de Iguaçu waterfalls, which border the canyon of the Iguazu River. To say that this is a magnificent sight does not in any way express the emotions that you will be subject to. The waterfalls are located in a national park with unique flora and fauna. They arose as a result of a volcanic eruption and the displacement of the earth's strata.  The name of the waterfalls means "big water" in Guaraní. 275 waterfalls, each with its own name, merge into one, crashing into the Devil's Throat Gorge. The sight of water spray in a halo of the rainbow spectrum is simply fascinating. On the way to the most powerful waterfall called "Devil's Throat" you will see many small waterfalls. Rainbow splashes, billions of drops of falling water and magnificent landscapes cause incomparable delight. 

Macuco Safari

By jeep you will take a thrilling safari through the jungle. You will be accompanied by a guide with information about this National Park. Through the jungle and then on foot, you come to the specialized platform of the Iguazu River, where you will have an impressive boat trip under the waterfalls. There, on a specially equipped boat, you swim very close to the waterfalls. Unique views not only of the waterfalls, but also of the slopes of the mountains covered with tropical greenery. Breathtaking and adrenaline in the blood when you find yourself under a continuous stream of water falling from above and a unique view of the waterfalls. You can order a DVD and then you will watch it for a long time!

Enjoy a delicious lunch in the park

Bird Park 

It is located near the Iguazu National Park. 

You will enter huge aviaries, in which amazing, fabulous birds of outlandish colors freely fly or walk among the rainforest.

At night we invite you to degustate a typical Argentina chefs specialty and accompany the process of making that delicious Argentinian barbecue to enjoy the delicacies accompanied with a good glass of wine
